modules.name: Animation3D
modules.description: Keyframe clips (position, rotation slerp, scale; linear or step) sampled in native code and applied to Scene3D nodes by players advanced in one Loop system.

modules.name: Archive
modules.description: Read zip, tar, tar.gz and gzip archives: list, read entries into memory, extract safely (also on a background worker), and gzip data in memory.

modules.name: Box2D
modules.description: 2D rigid body physics with Box2D 3.2: worlds, bodies, shapes, chains, seven joint types, ray/shape casts, overlap queries, character movers and contact, sensor and body events.

modules.name: Box2DDraw
modules.description: Debug drawing of Box2D worlds: shape outlines, joints, bounds, contacts and centers of mass, batched on the GS.

modules.name: Camera2D
modules.description: 2D cameras applied in C to Draw, Image, Font and TileMap: position, zoom, rotation and viewport (split screen), follow with smoothing, dead zone, lookahead and auto zoom, bounds and zones, shake, parallax, culling helpers, timed zoom/pan, fades, flashes, letterbox and transitions between cameras.

modules.name: Camera3D
modules.description: Independent 3D cameras, validated right-handed projection, reusable matrix outputs and native frustum tests.

modules.name: CameraRig3D
modules.description: Native Camera3D controllers: follow a Scene3D node with local or world offsets, orbit with limits, zoom and auto-rotation, frame-rate independent smoothing; advanced in one Loop system after the scene update.

modules.name: CD/DVD
modules.description: Disc filesystem driver (cdfs): boot from and read cdrom0:/cdfs:.

modules.name: Collision
modules.description: Light 2D collision and simple physics in C, next to Box2D: rectangles and circles in a spatial hash, tile grids with solid tiles, one-way platforms and slopes, swept movement that slides on walls and never tunnels, gravity, bounce and moving platforms that carry riders, layers and masks, queries, overlapping pairs and raycasts, stepped by the Loop.

modules.name: Collision3D
modules.description: Light 3D collision in C: static triangles of level meshes, glTF scenes and boxes in a bounding volume hierarchy, raycasts, sphere casts and overlaps with layers, and kinematic characters (an upright ellipsoid) that walk with collide-and-slide: gravity, walkable slopes, steps, ground snapping, no tunneling, driving a Scene3D node from one Loop system.

modules.name: Color
modules.description: RGBA color construction and component manipulation.

modules.name: Debug
modules.description: On-screen diagnostics: stats overlay (FPS, CPU and frame time, RAM, JS heap, VRAM) with a frame-time graph, watches, the script's console output, shapes and text in screen or world space, and a controller shortcut. Graph and console tail in C.

modules.name: Draw
modules.description: Immediate-mode 2D primitive drawing.

modules.name: Ease
modules.description: Easing curves (Penner families, steps, cubic-bezier) and interpolation helpers: lerp, remap, smoothstep and frame-rate independent damping. Written in JavaScript.

modules.name: Native Modules (ERL)
modules.description: Loads relocatable native modules (.erl) at runtime, e.g. import from 'mymodule.erl'. Exports every symbol of the binary, which costs RAM and disables dead-code removal.

modules.name: Font
modules.description: TrueType and bitmap font loading and text rendering.

modules.name: Gamepad
modules.description: Controller input for up to eight players: DualShock 2 and other PS2 pads on both ports and multitaps, DualShock 3/4 over USB and Bluetooth.

modules.name: GLTF3D
modules.description: glTF 2.0 / GLB scenes: node hierarchy as Scene3D nodes (TRS or decomposed matrices), every triangle primitive as a Model3D mesh, and animations as Animation3D clips that play on the loaded nodes.

modules.name: Graphics
modules.description: PS2 GS initialization, frame control, colors, and 2D primitives.

modules.name: Internal HDD
modules.description: Internal hard disk drivers for exFAT/FAT32 disks (not PFS): boot from and access mass:/. Needs the network adapter or a console with a built-in HDD bay.

modules.name: i.LINK Storage
modules.description: i.LINK (IEEE 1394) storage drivers, on the consoles that have the port: boot from and access mass:/.

modules.name: Image
modules.description: Image loading, texture ownership, and textured drawing.

modules.name: ImageList
modules.description: Safe cooperative asynchronous image loading.

modules.name: IOP
modules.description: IOP module discovery, loading, reset, and memory statistics.

modules.name: Lights
modules.description: Independent ambient and four directional lights, validated linear intensities, normalized world directions and revision tracking.

modules.name: Loop
modules.description: Game loop driven by the runtime: clears the screen, calls a per-frame callback with the native delta time and flips.

modules.name: Matrix4
modules.description: Four-by-four transformation matrix type.

modules.name: Memory Card
modules.description: Memory card drivers (sio2man, mcman, mcserv) and the MemoryCard API: card status, files, directories, attributes, icon.sys, format and background jobs on mc0:/mc1:.

modules.name: Model3D
modules.description: Immutable meshes, copied materials, normals, UVs and retained opaque textures. Static OBJ/glTF loading with explicit unsupported-feature errors.

modules.name: Mutex
modules.description: Binary mutual-exclusion primitives backed by EE semaphores.

modules.name: MX4SIO
modules.description: MX4SIO (SD card adapter in memory card slot 2) drivers: boot from and access mass:/. Slot 2 then no longer reads memory cards.

modules.name: Noise
modules.description: Procedural noise in C: Perlin and simplex (2D/3D), Worley, fBm/ridged/billow with domain warp, and batch fills of Float32Array grids (also in the background) classified into TileMap tile ids.

modules.name: Particles2D
modules.description: Native 2D particle emitters: pooled emission (rate and bursts), gravity, drag, size/colour over life, rotation and spin, integrated in C and drawn by a VU1 program that builds each rotated quad through the 2D view; one Loop system for every emitter.

modules.name: Particles3D
modules.description: Native 3D particle emitters (cone emission, gravity, drag, size/colour over life) integrated in C and drawn as camera-facing billboards by a VU1 program, depth tested against the 3D scene without writing depth.

modules.name: Physics3D
modules.description: Rigid bodies in C: dynamic, kinematic and static spheres, boxes and capsules with sequential impulses, friction, restitution, warm starting and island sleeping, ball/hinge/distance/weld joints, colliding with each other and with the static triangles of a Collision3D world; bodies drive Scene3D nodes and each world steps in its own Loop system with fixed 1/60 s substeps.

modules.name: Power Off
modules.description: IOP poweroff driver, started from athena.ini or IOP.loadModule().

modules.name: Quaternion
modules.description: Owned xyzw quaternions, shortest-path slerp and right-handed TRS in native code.

modules.name: Random
modules.description: Seedable random generators (xoshiro128**): integers, floats, booleans, gaussian, pick, shuffle, weighted choice and savable state.

modules.name: Render3D
modules.description: Opaque color and perspective-correct textured rendering, Gouraud diffuse lighting, precise native clipping, retained batches, explicit-matrix mesh draws and inline DMA geometry.

modules.name: Scene
modules.description: Scenes with a lifecycle (enter, update, draw, pause, resume, exit), a stack for pause menus and dialogs, fade transitions, a loading screen, and reference-counted assets loaded in the background (images, sprite sheets, sound effects, music, fonts, JSON), kept while two scenes share them. Written in JavaScript.

modules.name: Scene3D
modules.description: Native 3D transform hierarchy with rejected cycles, dirty propagation, subtree bounds culling, pipeline-sorted render queue and optional Loop update system.

modules.name: Screen
modules.description: Screen mode, frame control, GS parameters, and display synchronization.

modules.name: Sound
modules.description: Audio through audsrv: ADPCM sound effects on the 24 SPU2 voices and a streamed WAV/OGG music track. audsrv is loaded on the IOP on first use.

modules.name: Sprite
modules.description: Spritesheets (grids, Aseprite and TexturePacker JSON with trimmed and rotated frames, tags and slices, loadable in the background) and animation clips (fps or per-frame durations, loop, once and pingpong, chained clips, frame events, promises), animated sprites with origin, scale, rotation and flip, batched drawing, and batch animation of TileMap sprites, all advanced in C by the Loop.

modules.name: System Core
modules.description: Core system utilities: high-resolution timers, memory usage statistics, explicit garbage collection, and process controls.

modules.name: Thread
modules.description: Multi-threading and task management primitives backed by the EE kernel scheduler.

modules.name: TileMap
modules.description: VU1-accelerated batched sprite and tilemap rendering.

modules.name: Timer
modules.description: Pauseable elapsed-time timers backed by the EE clock.

modules.name: Tween
modules.description: Tweens: animate numeric and color properties of any object with easing, delays, repeats and yoyo; awaitable, driven by the Loop. Written in JavaScript.

modules.name: Tween3D
modules.description: Tweens of native 3D targets (Scene3D nodes, Model3D instances, Camera3D cameras) advanced in C: the Ease curves in native code, delay, repeat, yoyo, overwrite and awaitable handles, without a JavaScript call per frame.

modules.name: USB Mass Storage
modules.description: USB storage drivers (usbd, bdm, FAT, usbmass_bd): boot from and access mass:/.

modules.name: Vector
modules.description: Vector2, Vector3 and Vector4 PS2-aligned math types.

modules.name: Video
modules.description: MPEG-1/2 elementary video streams (.m2v) decoded by the IPU through libmpeg, drawn directly or used as an Image texture. One video can be open at a time.
